reg_deadline.en: Your application must reach a board of elections by Saturday, October 24, 2026, by mail or in person. New York has no Election Day registration.
reg_deadline.es: Tu solicitud debe llegar a una junta electoral (board of elections) a más tardar el sábado 24 de octubre de 2026, por correo o en persona. New York no tiene registro el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: Applications must be received by a board of elections no later than October 24, 2026 to be eligible to vote in the General Election.
reg_deadline.en_after: Registration closed October 24, 2026. Not sure you're registered? Check the state's voter lookup.
reg_deadline.es_after: El registro cerró el 24 de octubre de 2026. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Revisa la búsqueda de votantes del estado.

mail_request.en: To get an early mail ballot by mail, your county board of elections must receive your application by Saturday, October 24, 2026. To pick one up in person, apply by Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es: Para recibir una boleta anticipada por correo (early mail ballot), la junta electoral de tu condado debe recibir tu solicitud a más tardar el sábado 24 de octubre de 2026. Para recogerla en persona, solicítala a más tardar el lunes 2 de noviembre.
mail_request.quote: Applications requesting to receive an early mail ballot must be received by the board of elections in your county no later than ten days before the election.
mail_request.en_after: Applications to get a ballot by mail closed October 24. You can still apply in person at your county board of elections through Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes para recibir la boleta por correo cerraron el 24 de octubre. Todavía puedes solicitarla en persona en la junta electoral de tu condado hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre.

mail_return.en: Mail: postmarked by Tuesday, November 3, and received by Tuesday, November 10, 2026. In person: at your county board of elections or any poll site in your county by 9 p.m. on November 3, or at an early voting site in your county from October 24 to November 1.
mail_return.es: Por correo: con matasellos del martes 3 de noviembre o antes, y recibida a más tardar el martes 10 de noviembre de 2026. En persona: en la junta electoral de tu condado o en cualquier lugar de votación de tu condado a más tardar a las 9 p. m. del 3 de noviembre, o en un centro de votación anticipada de tu condado del 24 de octubre al 1 de noviembre.
mail_return.quote: Put it in the mail ensuring it receives a postmark no later than November 3rd. Must be received by the County Board of Elections no later than November 10th.
mail_return.en_after: Mail: postmarked by Tuesday, November 3, and received by Tuesday, November 10, 2026. In person: at your county board of elections or any poll site in your county by 9 p.m. on November 3.
mail_return.es_after: Por correo: con matasellos del martes 3 de noviembre o antes, y recibida a más tardar el martes 10 de noviembre de 2026. En persona: en la junta electoral de tu condado o en cualquier lugar de votación de tu condado a más tardar a las 9 p. m. del 3 de noviembre.

early_hours.en: Each county board of elections sets its own hours, so check your county's schedule before you go. In New York City, early voting sites are open 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Thursday, October 29, and 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Friday, October 30 through Sunday, November 1.
early_hours.es: La junta electoral de cada condado fija su propio horario, así que revisa el de tu condado antes de ir. En New York City, los centros de votación anticipada abren de 8 a. m. a 4 p. m. el jueves 29 de octubre, y de 9 a. m. a 5 p. m. del viernes 30 de octubre al domingo 1 de noviembre.
early_hours.quote: Early voting runs from October 24 to November 1. ... Thursday, October 29: 8 AM to 4 PM; Friday, October 30: 9 AM to 5 PM; Saturday, October 31: 9 AM to 5 PM; Sunday, November 1: 9 AM to 5 PM
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended Sunday, November 1. Vote at your Election Day polling place, open 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. on November 3.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el domingo 1 de noviembre. Vota en tu lugar de votación del Día de las Elecciones, que abre de 6 a. m. a 9 p. m. el 3 de noviembre.
early_hours.notes: County-sets-hours rule is also on elections.ny.gov/early-voting (read 2026-10-21). NYC hours from NYC311 general election guide, read 2026-10-28 by WebFetch. That page also says mail ballots must be received by November 11; the state Board's Request a Ballot page says November 10 for the 2026 general, and Election Law 9-209(3)(e) and 8-412 point to Nov 10, so the page keeps Nov 10.

cure.en: Got a cure notice from your county board of elections? Your signed cure form must reach the board within seven business days after the notice was mailed, or by 5 p.m. on Tuesday, November 10, whichever is later.
cure.es: ¿Recibiste un aviso de corrección (cure notice) de la junta electoral de tu condado? Tu formulario de corrección firmado debe llegar a la junta dentro de los siete días hábiles después de que te enviaron el aviso, o a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del martes 10 de noviembre, lo que sea más tarde.
cure.quote: Such cure affirmation shall be received by the board no later than seven business days after the board's mailing of such curable rejection notice or by five p.m. on the seventh day following the election, whichever is later.
cure.notes: Seventh day after Nov 3 = Tue Nov 10 (computed). Read in Chrome 2026-10-28 (revision 2024-09-06).

in_person.en: During early voting, October 24 to November 1, you can go to any of your assigned early voting centers in your county. In New York City you're assigned one early voting site. You mark and scan your ballot just like on Election Day.
in_person.es: Durante la votación anticipada, del 24 de octubre al 1 de noviembre, puedes ir a cualquiera de los centros de votación anticipada que te asignaron en tu condado. En la ciudad de New York te asignan un solo centro de votación anticipada. Marcas y escaneas tu boleta igual que el Día de las Elecciones.
in_person.quote: Voters may visit any of their assigned Early Voting Centers in their county, except in New York City, where voters are assigned to one early voting site.
in_person.en_after: Early voting ran October 24 to November 1.
in_person.es_after: La votación anticipada fue del 24 de octubre al 1 de noviembre.

first_time.en: Use the Board of Elections' poll site and voter lookup to confirm you're registered and to find both your early voting site and your Election Day polling place.
first_time.es: Usa la búsqueda de votantes y lugares de votación de la Junta Electoral para confirmar que estás registrado y encontrar tu centro de votación anticipada y tu lugar de votación del Día de las Elecciones.
first_time.quote: Use the Board of Elections' poll site and voter look up to confirm your registration status, and find your election day and early voting polling place.

locator_label.en: Poll site and voter lookup (New York State Board of Elections)
locator_label.es: Búsqueda de votantes y lugares de votación (Junta Electoral del Estado de New York)

rule.en: At the wrong poll site, or not in the poll book? Poll workers will tell you your correct polling place. If your record is missing there, you can sign an affidavit and vote an affidavit ballot.
rule.es: ¿Estás en el lugar de votación equivocado o no apareces en el registro? Los trabajadores electorales te dirán cuál es tu lugar de votación correcto. Si ahí no aparece tu registro, puedes firmar una declaración jurada y votar con una boleta de declaración jurada (affidavit ballot).
rule.quote: advise the voter of the correct polling place and election district for the residence address provided by the voter to such poll clerk or election inspector.

en: A current and valid photo ID
Another government document with your name and address
es: Una identificación con foto vigente y válida
Un cheque del gobierno o un talón de pago
Otro documento del gobierno con tu nombre y dirección
accepted.quote: presents to the appropriate election inspector, clerk or coordinator a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document that shows the name and address of the voter

expired.en: Only some first-time voters need ID: those who registered by mail and haven't voted for a federal office in their county before. A photo ID has to be current and valid.
expired.es: Solo algunos votantes nuevos necesitan identificación: quienes se registraron por correo y nunca han votado por un cargo federal en su condado. Una identificación con foto debe estar vigente y ser válida.
expired.quote: presents to the appropriate election inspector, clerk or coordinator a current and valid photo identification

without.en: Asked for ID and don't have it? You can still vote an affidavit ballot, and it counts as long as you're otherwise an eligible voter.
without.es: ¿Te piden identificación y no la tienes? Igual puedes votar con una boleta de declaración jurada (affidavit ballot), y se cuenta siempre que cumplas los demás requisitos para votar.
without.quote: may cast an affidavit ballot, and notwithstanding this section of law, such affidavit ballot shall be duly cast and counted

who.en: Any registered voter can apply for an early mail ballot, no reason needed. Apply in person at your county board of elections through Monday, November 2. Already got a mail ballot? You can't vote on a machine, but you can vote in person with an affidavit ballot. It counts only if your mail ballot never reached the board.
who.es: Cualquier votante registrado puede pedir una boleta de votación anticipada por correo (early mail ballot), sin dar una razón. Pídela en persona en la junta electoral de tu condado hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre. ¿Ya te dieron una boleta por correo? No puedes votar en la máquina, pero puedes votar en persona con una boleta de declaración jurada (affidavit ballot). Cuenta solo si tu boleta por correo nunca llegó a la junta.
who.quote: Voters who have already been issued a ballot can still vote in person using an affidavit ballot. ... If the voter’s ballot has been received, the affidavit ballot will not be counted. If the voter’s ballot has not been received, the affidavit ballot will be counted.
who.notes: Read in Chrome 2026-10-28. Nov 2 in-person deadline: 'applications must be received by your board no later than the day before the election' (same page).

witness.en: Put your ballot in the Security Envelope, then sign and date the outside of that envelope and seal it. It goes in the prepaid Return Envelope, so no stamp needed.
witness.es: Mete tu boleta en el sobre de seguridad (Security Envelope), luego firma y pon la fecha afuera de ese sobre y séllalo. Va dentro del sobre de devolución con porte pagado, así que no necesita estampilla.
witness.quote: Sign and date the outside of the Security Envelope.

cure.en: Some envelope mistakes can be fixed, such as a missing signature or a signature that doesn't match. Your county board of elections sends you a notice and a cure form, and also emails or calls if it has your contact information. You can return the form in person, by mail or by email.
cure.es: Algunos errores en el sobre se pueden corregir, como que falte la firma o que la firma no coincida. La junta electoral de tu condado te manda un aviso y un formulario de corrección, y también te escribe o te llama si tiene tus datos de contacto. Puedes devolver el formulario en persona, por correo o por email.
cure.quote: A curable defect includes instances where the ballot envelope: (i) is unsigned; (ii) has a signature that does not correspond to the registration signature ... A cure affirmation, at the option of any voter submitting such cure affirmation, may be transmitted to the board of elections in person, by mail or in electronic form as an attachment to an email.

dropbox.en: You can hand in your ballot at any early voting site in your county from October 24 to November 1, or at any poll site in your county or your county board of elections by 9 p.m. on November 3.
dropbox.es: Puedes entregar tu boleta en cualquier centro de votación anticipada de tu condado del 24 de octubre al 1 de noviembre, o en cualquier lugar de votación de tu condado o en la junta electoral de tu condado a más tardar a las 9 p. m. del 3 de noviembre.
dropbox.quote: Bringing it to an early voting poll site in your county between October 24th and November 1st.
dropbox.en_after: You can hand in your ballot at any poll site in your county or your county board of elections by 9 p.m. on November 3.
dropbox.es_after: Puedes entregar tu boleta en cualquier lugar de votación de tu condado o en la junta electoral de tu condado a más tardar a las 9 p. m. del 3 de noviembre.

gear.en: Leave the campaign buttons at home. While polls are open, no political banner, button, poster or placard is allowed in the polling place or within 100 feet of its entrances.
gear.es: Deja en casa los botones de campaña. Mientras los lugares de votación están abiertos, no se permite ninguna pancarta, botón, póster ni letrero político dentro del lugar de votación ni a menos de 100 pies de sus entradas.
gear.quote: no political banner, button, poster or placard shall be allowed in or upon the polling place or within such one hundred foot radial.

phone.notes: Election Law 8-104 does not address phones. The ballot selfie rule (Election Law 17-130) is already in the FAQ.

line.en: Polls close at 9 p.m. If you're in line or inside the polling place by then, you'll be allowed to vote.
line.es: Los lugares de votación cierran a las 9 p. m. Si estás en la fila o dentro del lugar de votación a esa hora, te dejarán votar.
line.quote: Voters entitled to vote who are on line or in the polling place at the time fixed by law for the closing of the polls shall be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: Ulster County's Board of Elections runs a student I Voted sticker contest, now in its sixth year. More than 300 students ages 9 to 18 sent in designs, and the public voted on six finalists. Bea, a 7th grader at Mountain Laurel Waldorf School, got the most votes. The county says the top design goes to all its voters on November 3, 2026.
tradition.es: La junta electoral del condado de Ulster (Board of Elections) organiza un concurso estudiantil de stickers de I Voted, que ya va en su sexto año. Más de 300 estudiantes de 9 a 18 años mandaron diseños, y el público votó entre seis finalistas. Bea, estudiante de 7.º grado de Mountain Laurel Waldorf School, sacó más votos. El condado dice que el diseño ganador se reparte a todos sus votantes el 3 de noviembre de 2026.
tradition.quote: The design with the most votes will be produced and distributed to all voters at the November 3, 2026 General Election. Special thanks to the more than 300 student artists that contributed designs this year! Bea Henry – Age 12, Mountain Laurel Waldorf School, 7th Grade 28.36%
tradition.notes: Read by curl 2026-10-28 (Chrome extension lacks permission on this domain). Student is a minor: first name and school only. Mail-voter sticker at the BOE office comes only from radio news; not used.

early.en: In New York City, the city's 2026 general election guide tells voters at early voting and Election Day poll sites to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before they leave. Other counties set their own practice.
early.es: En la ciudad de Nueva York, la guía de la ciudad para las elecciones generales de 2026 les dice a quienes votan en persona, por anticipado o el Día de las Elecciones, que recojan un sticker oficial de "I Voted" antes de salir. Los demás condados deciden por su cuenta.
early.quote: Don't forget to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before you leave!

mail.notes: Checked 2026-10-28, no official statement found on stickers for early mail or absentee voters: NYC311 general election guide (sticker only at poll sites), Ulster County contest page ('distributed to all voters at the November 3, 2026 General Election', no word on how mail voters get one), elections.ny.gov, Monroe, Erie and Westchester board sites (no sticker pages found), Genesee, Albany and Tioga contests (polling sites). WHEC news quotes the State Board saying counties may buy stickers at their discretion; news only, not used.

more.en: Jeslyn, 15, of Morrisville won the county's 2026 sticker art contest. Her design shows a bald eagle flying with I Voted across its wings over the American flag, and it is handed out to voters at the November election.
more.es: Jeslyn, de 15 años, de Morrisville, ganó el concurso de arte para el sticker 2026 del condado. Su diseño muestra un águila calva que vuela con I Voted en las alas sobre la bandera de Estados Unidos, y se reparte a los votantes en las elecciones de noviembre.
more.en_after: Jeslyn, 15, of Morrisville won the county's 2026 sticker art contest. Her design shows a bald eagle flying with I Voted across its wings over the American flag, and it was handed out at the November 2026 election.
more.es_after: Jeslyn, de 15 años, de Morrisville, ganó el concurso de arte para el sticker 2026 del condado. Su diseño muestra un águila calva que vuela con I Voted en las alas sobre la bandera de Estados Unidos, y se repartió en las elecciones de noviembre de 2026.
more.quote: Church’s design will be featured on a sticker to be given out to Madison County voters during the 2026 General Election in November.
more.notes: Full name and age on the page; first name and town here.

more.en: Local students won the county's 2026 I Voted sticker contest. Their winning designs are turned into the stickers handed out at polling places.
more.es: Estudiantes de la zona ganaron el concurso de stickers I Voted 2026 del condado. Sus diseños ganadores se convierten en los stickers que se reparten en los lugares de votación.
more.quote: The winning designs will be turned into stickers and distributed at polling locations, featured in Genesee County Board of Elections communications, and shared on the Genesee County Board of Elections website.
more.en_after: Local students won the county's 2026 I Voted sticker contest. Their winning designs were turned into the stickers handed out at polling places.
more.es_after: Estudiantes de la zona ganaron el concurso de stickers I Voted 2026 del condado. Sus diseños ganadores se convirtieron en los stickers que se repartieron en los lugares de votación.
more.notes: Read in Chrome by screenshot (curl and text reading blocked). Winner names and schools below the fold, not read today, so left out.

more.en: Leo, a homeschooled 9th grader, drew the 2026 I Voted sticker: a lake and pine forest framed by flag stripes and stars. Addie and Fiona, 5th graders at Lansing Middle School, drew Future Voter stickers for kids who come along to the polls. The I Voted sticker goes to all general election voters.
more.es: Leo, estudiante de 9.º grado que estudia en casa, dibujó el sticker I Voted 2026: un lago y un bosque de pinos enmarcados por franjas y estrellas de la bandera. Addie y Fiona, estudiantes de 5.º grado en Lansing Middle School, dibujaron los stickers Future Voter para los niños que acompañan a su familia a votar. El sticker I Voted se entrega a todos los votantes de las elecciones generales.
more.en_after: Leo, a homeschooled 9th grader, drew the 2026 I Voted sticker: a lake and pine forest framed by flag stripes and stars. Addie and Fiona, 5th graders at Lansing Middle School, drew Future Voter stickers for kids who came along to the polls.
more.es_after: Leo, estudiante de 9.º grado que estudia en casa, dibujó el sticker I Voted 2026: un lago y un bosque de pinos enmarcados por franjas y estrellas de la bandera. Addie y Fiona, estudiantes de 5.º grado en Lansing Middle School, dibujaron los stickers Future Voter para los niños que acompañaron a su familia a votar.
more.quote: Stickers with the winning design will be printed and distributed to all general election voters.
more.notes: Winners, grades and schools read in the 2026 Winners image on the page (Chrome screenshot; curl gets 403). Full names on the page.

more.en: The winner of the county's first student sticker contest, picked by a public vote from six finalists, is printed on the I Voted stickers handed out at polling places in 2026.
more.es: El diseño ganador del primer concurso de stickers para estudiantes del condado, elegido por votación pública entre seis finalistas, se imprime en los stickers I Voted que se reparten en los lugares de votación en 2026.
more.en_after: The winner of the county's first student sticker contest, picked by a public vote from six finalists, was printed on the I Voted stickers handed out at polling places in 2026.
more.es_after: El diseño ganador del primer concurso de stickers para estudiantes del condado, elegido por votación pública entre seis finalistas, se imprimió en los stickers I Voted que se repartieron en los lugares de votación en 2026.
more.quote: The winning design will be printed on official “I Voted” stickers and distributed to voters at polling locations throughout Dutchess County during the 2026 General Election.
more.notes: Release July 9, 2026 (55 entries, six finalists). Winner named only in news (Highlands Current Oct 26), so not named here.

provisional.en: New York calls it an affidavit ballot. You vote one when your record is missing from the poll book at your correct polling place, or you moved within the state and didn't update your address. You sign a sworn statement that you're registered and still qualified to vote there. It counts only if the board finds you were entitled to vote, for example if your registration reached a board by October 24 but your name was left off the list. It doesn't register you for this election.
provisional.es: En New York se llama boleta de declaración jurada (affidavit ballot). Votas con una cuando tu nombre no aparece en el registro de votantes de tu lugar de votación correcto, o te mudaste dentro del estado y no actualizaste tu dirección. Firmas una declaración jurada de que estás registrado y todavía puedes votar ahí. Cuenta solo si la junta encuentra que tenías derecho a votar, por ejemplo si tu registro llegó a una junta a más tardar el 24 de octubre pero tu nombre no apareció en la lista. No te registra para esta elección.
provisional.quote: If the central board of canvassers determines that a person was entitled to vote at such election it shall cast and canvass such affidavit ballot ... If a voter registration application for a person was received by a board of elections by the tenth day prior to the election, an affidavit ballot from the person shall be cast and counted if the voter is otherwise qualified to vote in such election
provisional.notes: When to vote one is from Election Law 8-302 (read 2026-10-21). Counting rules from 9-209(7), read 2026-10-28. Tenth day before Nov 3 = Oct 24, the same day as the registration deadline and the first day of early voting (9-209(7)(i) covers people who registered at an early voting site under 8-604). 'Doesn't register you' rests on 9-209(7)(a) ('entitled to vote'): an affidavit ballot from someone with no timely registration isn't counted.

line.en: You still get to vote. Anyone eligible who is in line or inside the polling place at closing time, 9 p.m., must be allowed to vote.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Cualquier persona con derecho a votar que esté en la fila o dentro del lugar de votación a la hora de cierre, las 9 p. m., debe poder votar.
line.quote: Voters entitled to vote who are on line or in the polling place at the time fixed by law for the closing of the polls shall be allowed to vote.

track.en: Look up your ballot with the Board of Elections' Poll Site Search, Voter Registration, and Mail Ballot Tracker at voterlookup.elections.ny.gov.
track.es: Busca tu boleta en la herramienta de la Junta Electoral para buscar lugares de votación, registro y rastrear boletas por correo, en voterlookup.elections.ny.gov.
track.quote: Voters can track their early mail ballot via the Board of Elections' Poll Site Search, Voter Registration, and Mail Ballot Tracker available at https://voterlookup.elections.ny.gov/

late_mail.en: It has to be postmarked by November 3 and reach your county board of elections by November 10. The Postal Service suggests mailing about seven days ahead. Mailing on Election Day? Check the box's last pickup time, or hand it in at a poll site in your county by 9 p.m. instead.
late_mail.es: Debe tener matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llegar a la junta electoral de tu condado a más tardar el 10 de noviembre. El Servicio Postal sugiere enviarla unos siete días antes. ¿La mandas el Día de las Elecciones? Revisa la última hora de recolección del buzón, o mejor entrégala en un lugar de votación de tu condado antes de las 9 p. m.
late_mail.quote: ballots entered after the last posted collection time will not be postmarked until the following business day.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 in Chrome (elections.ny.gov and nysenate.gov return 403 to curl and WebFetch): Early Voting, Registration and Voting Deadlines, Request a Ballot, Ways to Vote; Election Law 8-104 (electioneering, line rule), 8-302 (affidavit ballots), 8-303 (first-time voter ID). The 2026 Political Calendar is a PDF that could not be read in this session, so the cure deadline was not found; the Board's cure page redirects to a 2021 guidance PDF. The early mail ballot in-person deadline ('no later than the day before the election') is November 2. No phone rule found. Sticker tradition is Ulster County's official contest page; the winner is named only in news reports, so it is not stated.

hours.en: Polling places are open 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 6 a. m. a 9 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: the general election from six o'clock in the morning until nine o'clock in the evening
